DKV · DESAIN KOMUNIKASI VISUAL

I love observing the quiet geometry of everyday life and finding intention in the spaces between lines. As a Visual Communication Design student, I believe that art isn't just something we create. It’s a constant practice of paying attention. I try to translate the subtle rhythms of the world into visual compositions that speak softly, yet linger long after you look away.
